leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply flexbox properties to horizontally and vertically center elements within a container
Configure grid layout properties to achieve precise centering of content
Implement text-align and line-height techniques for inline and text element centering
Manipulate margin and positioning properties to center block-level elements
Construct responsive centering solutions that adapt to different screen sizes
Integrate multiple centering methods within a single layout to solve complex alignment challenges
Initialize transform-based centering for elements with dynamic dimensions
